thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — SLO burn rate alert for /generate endpoint (multi-window). Current metrics: burn_rate_5m=480, burn_rate_1h=42. Severity: page by default.

Maya R: taking this, doing a quick impact sweep. pinging Raj and Oliver for infra + routing.

Raj P: seeing 502s and tail latency spikes in eu-west; about ~2-3% of requests for a subset of customers timed out. Not system-wide but affects low-qps tenants.

Jess K: pulling the multi-window dashboard now. give me a sec.

sre-bot: automated mitigations triggered: scale_up_gpu_pool (requested +2 nodes), enable_fallback_model_v2 (route 15% of traffic). Runbook steps 1-3 executed.

Oliver B: quick thought — current pager rule pages on 5m burn > 300 which can be noisy during warmup. propose gating: page if (5m>600) OR (5m>300 AND 1h>50). That would reduce noisy pages while still alerting sustained burns.

Maya R: agreed in principle. For now we need immediate traffic mitigation. Raj, can you reduce personalization experiment traffic? that experiment is heavy on KV cache and amplifies tail.

Raj P: lowering experiment fraction to 0.2 now: `curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/route -d '{ "experiment": "personalization", "fraction": 0.2 }'` -> accepted, traffic migrating.

Jess K: dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/multi-window-burn?orgId=1 . 5m burn dropped from 480 -> 340 after routing change. still trending down but not stable.

Oliver B: pushing a temporary alert rule patch to avoid more pages while we stabilize. Proposed Prometheus change: 
```
- alert: SLOBurnPaging
  expr: burn_rate_5m > 300
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
to
```
- alert: SLOBurnPaging
  expr: (burn_rate_5m > 600) OR (burn_rate_5m > 300 and burn_rate_1h > 50)
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
This only affects paging severity; slack/ops notifications remain for visibility. Pushing now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: config-change applied by Oliver B (change id cfg-7891). Pager suppression window in effect until evaluation.

Maya R: also enabling KV cache warmup parallelism to reduce tail latency. Queuing infra change now.

Raj P: warmup parallelism set to 8. triggering warmup workloads.

Jess K: ~20 minutes since mitigations. 5m burn now 120, 1h at 38. customer-visible errors trending back to baseline. No new pages in last 10m.

Oliver B: recommend follow-up actions: create INF ticket to formalize paging gating, add decision matrix to ops dashboard, and update runbook. I'll file INF-2198 for infra + alerting changes.

Maya R: I'll own the runbook updates and a short post-incident note. I'll include the gating logic and a play for quick routing throttles. ETA: EOD.

Nina (Product Ops): I'll prepare customer outreach list for any tenants who saw timeouts. Opening INF-2199 for comms.

sre-bot: automated: Incident state -> mitigated. Fallback routing set back to 0. Auto-check scheduled in 30m to confirm stable 1h window.

Oliver B: Action list (captured):
- (Oliver) PR with alert rule change to infra repo (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/563)
- (Maya) Update runbook + postmortem summary and publish to #incidents
- (Raj) Capture perf traces for KV cache and attach to INF-2200
- (Jess) Add new multi-window decision panel to oncall dashboard
- (Nina) Draft customer comms and coordinate outreach

Maya R: assigning owners in INF-2198/2199/2200 now. Also suggest we review SLO budget policy — multi-window attribution may be adjusted in the next reliability RFC to avoid single-window panic pages.

Raj P: filing trace/logs -> INF-2200 (attached CPU/GPU logs and tail traces).

Jess K: quick ops snippet to include in runbook: `alert_conditions = { short_window: 5m>600, medium_window: 30m>200, long_window: 1h>50 }` — use matrix to decide paging vs slack-only.

incident-bot: Incident closed. Duration ~42m. Crosslinking: INF-2198, INF-2199, INF-2200.

Maya R: thanks everyone. We'll review during the reliability retro and consider adjusting default burn-rate thresholds + paging gating. :thumbsup:

Oliver B: optional long-term: require cross-window confirmation for paging (short+long) for non-service-degrading burns. add to RFC backlog.

Nina (Product Ops): noted for comms. I'll stand by for postmortem to finalize outreach.

Jess K: leaving this thread with dashboard link and PR links in INF tickets.

Maya R: closing out here. good job team.
